premises.text: Sites waste personalization spend because users are diverse and moment-specific while historical segments and A/B cohorts miss real-time intent
premises.evidence_span: millions of dollars are spent every single year to get the right information in front of the right people. Almost all of this is wasted

premises.text: LiftIgniter personalizes in real time across verticals, content types, touchpoints, and devices, including cold-start users
premises.evidence_span: platform for every single vertical, across all types of content, across every single touchpoint, and across all devices

premises.text: Integration is minutes-fast: enter URL, choose site areas and goals/rules, and serve intelligent reactions in about 125 ms per user action as a cohort of one
premises.evidence_span: took minutes to integrate, not months

premises.text: SaaS pricing is usage-based so customers can add items and site areas to personalize easily
premises.evidence_span: pricing is usage-based, which means that it's very easy for our customers to add new items and new parts of the site

value.text: Serve users the items they love, want to buy, and want to share at the moment they care
value.evidence_span: give them the items they love, the items they want to buy, and the items they want to share
